{{Top|leg}}
'''Luskin's Landing''' was an underground [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] serving [[Exovar's Emporium]]. Located at the end of [[Ion Alley]] behind [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]], it was a well-equipped port staff by a crew of [[NR-5 Series Repair Droid]]s. Arrivals at the port did not have to provide crew or cargo manifests, but hazardous materials scans were carried out on first time visitors. Refueling and restocking [[Starship/Legends|starships]] were charged at a nominal free, repairs and modifications were available at discount prices, and a minimal docking fee was collected from all ships. Security was maintained by three [[K4 security droid]]s.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
